author: Ari Koslow
title: JR Ritchie to pitch out of bullpen for Braves
desc: JR Ritchie told reporters he'll be pitching out of the bullpen.
impact: Ritchie was recalled on Saturday. He'll add some length in the bullpen for Atlanta.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Spencer Bivens called up by Giants
desc: The Giants are calling up Spencer Bivens.
impact: Bivens will be up in the majors for the first time this season. Matt Gage went on the IL as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matt Gage (knee) to undergo MRI Monday
desc: Matt Gage is scheduled to undergo an MRI on Monday.
impact: Gage has been dealing with left elbow discomfort for roughly two weeks. There should be an update on his status later on next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Salvador Perez (elbow) not in lineup Saturday
desc: Salvador Perez is not in the Royals lineup on Saturday against the Phillies.
impact: Perez is continuing to deal with soreness in his right elbow. He remains day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zebby Matthews leaves early with foot injury Saturday
desc: The Twins say Zebby Matthews left Saturday's game with a right foot laceration.
impact: Matthews will head to be further evaluated. There should be another update on his status following the game.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Rhett Lowder to move to bullpen through All-Star break
desc: Reds manager Terry Francona said Rhett Lowder will be moved to the bullpen through the All-Star break.
impact: Lowder posted a 5.18 ERA over five starts in June. He'll add some length in the bullpen over the next week for Cincinnati.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zak Kent optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Nationals optioned Zak Kent to Triple-A Rochester.
impact: Kent will return to Triple-A to make room for Matt Krook.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Andre Granillo designated for assignment
desc: The Nationals designated Andre Granillo for assignment.
impact: Granillo loses his spot on the Nationals 40-man roster. He will head to waivers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matt Krook claimed off waivers by Nationals
desc: The Nationals claimed Matt Krook off waivers from the Athletics.
impact: Krook was designated for assignment by the Athletics. He will add more relief depth for Washington.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yandy Diaz gets day off Saturday
desc: Yandy Diaz is not in the Rays lineup on Saturday against the Astros.
impact: Diaz gets a day off after going 1-for-12 over his last three games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chandler Simpson (finger) not in lineup Saturday
desc: Chandler Simpson is not in the Rays lineup on Saturday.
impact: Simpson was scratched from Friday's lineup. He remains day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Joey Loperfido optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Astros optioned Joey Loperfido to Triple-A Sugar Land.
impact: Loperfido hit just .122 at the plate in June. He could get another opportunity later in the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Meyers optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Astros optioned Jake Meyers to Triple-A Sugar Land.
impact: Meyers hit just .183 at the plate in June. He'll look to work on some things in Triple-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: George Springer placed on Family Medical Emergency List
desc: The Blue Jays are placing Springer on the Family Medical Emergency List.
impact: Springer's time on the paternity list was set to expire Saturday. He'll be away for at least a few more days.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Coleman Crow (flexor strain) sent on rehab assignment
desc: Coleman Crow was sent on a rehab assignment with Triple-A Nashville.
impact: Crow has been on the injured list for the past month. He'll likely be looking at being activated after the All-Star break.
